about: Monza as built for 2026. Research: docs/superpowers/research/2026-10-17-track-surface/circuits-a.md §1 (FIA race director notes 2024-2026, press, OSM). Lap metres past the start line; apexes measured off the track: T1 907 R, T2 954 L, Curva Grande 1100-1700 R, T4 2122 L, T5 2171 R, Lesmo 1 2510-2560 R, Lesmo 2 2860 R, T8 3929 L, T9 4059 R, T10 4119 L, Alboreto 5128-5198 R; pit entry 5536, pit exit 471.
